model.label: GPT-6 Astra
model.trainingSetting: Frozen per-task in-context preparation; no weight updates

protocolChanges: Full/unseen only; 3 episodes per task rather than the 50-episode reference.
Fixed indices 5–7 are nested within the 1× cohort; 23 valid original outcomes were carried forward and 55 timeout failures were extended.
Extensions replay the original action prefix in a reinitialized simulator; endpoint restoration is approximate, with documented boundary validation.

aggregation.sr: 100 * successes / episodes per task/channel; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 settings.
aggregation.lscr: 100 * mean episode latched_stage_completion_rate, including failures; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 settings.
aggregation.efficiency: expert_time_step / mean successful steps_to_stable_success. Pool successful episodes across all four channels before calculating task mean efficiency. Overall values average task efficiencies over tasks with success; report valid-task counts.
aggregation.missing: null means unreported (NR). Efficiency without successes is null with no-success status. Valid-task counts are null when unreported, and 0 for an evaluated scope without successes.
aggregation.scope: Overall channel aggregates require all 26 settings. Four-channel means require all four channels. Never substitute Full-only scores for means or include duplicate reruns.

protocol.runtimeSnapshot: Evaluation snapshot recorded on 2026-10-19; scene metric contents and hashes attached
protocol.expertReference: All 26 recorded expert_time_step values match the checked official scene snapshot.
protocolChanges: Task09 stage metrics use an axis-corrected offline replay of saved 20 Hz states; SR and other online outcomes are retained. Original online metric frequency was 60 Hz.
Task27 retains the 2026-10-19 object_inside/tolerance=0.22 predicates; the checked current release uses container-local zone predicates for stages, terminal success and drop diagnostics.
Task42 retains stage order banana peel -> paper -> bottle; the checked current release uses paper -> bottle -> banana peel. These historical results were not rescored.

aggregation.sr: Equal mean of four channel success rates for each task, then equal mean across all 26 tasks.
aggregation.lscr: Mean episode latched stage completion, including failures; equal channel and task weighting.
aggregation.efficiency: For each task, expert_time_step * successful_episode_count / sum(successful steps_to_stable_success), pooled over four channels; equal mean over tasks with success.
aggregation.missing: No-success efficiency is null; overall efficiency reports its valid-task count.

model.label: MXI
model.trainingSetting: All 26 task policies fine-tuned by 1011.ai;no unmodified official Bench2Dex task checkpoint is included.
model.evaluationSetting: Independently executed native evaluations;task-specific fine-tuned checkpoints,each fixed across four channels;50 episodes/channel. PyTorch backend.
model.sourceLabel: 1011.ai independently executed all-self-finetuned evaluations;pending maintainer review

protocol.expertReference: Per-episode expert_time_step from released Bench2Dex scenes, in native physics steps; never substituted with policy actions or policy queries.
protocol.protocolChanges: Task-specific fine-tuned policies use the PyTorch backend. All routes use model horizon 20; RTC routes execute 16 with prefix 4, other routes execute 20. Native reach-and-stop uses the per-task dwell: 3.0 s for Task67 and 0.5 s for the other 25 tasks. Recorded episode budgets, seeds and perturbation samples are unchanged. Run-policy entry-point injection enables PyTorch policies; see sourceComparability. The exact simulator checkout has not been independently attested for every historical worker.

aggregation.sr: 100 * successes / 50 per channel; equal four-channel task mean; equal task mean over 26 tasks.
aggregation.lscr: 100 * mean episode latched_stage_completion_rate, including all failures; equal four-channel task mean; equal task mean over 26 tasks.
aggregation.efficiency: Per task, mean expert_time_step / mean steps_to_stable_success over successful episodes pooled across all four channels. Overall is the equal mean over tasks with success, with valid-task count reported. This is not a mean of per-episode ratios.
aggregation.score: 0.45 * SR + 0.45 * LSCR + 10 * efficiency; SR and LSCR are percentages.
aggregation.missing: Efficiency is null with no-success status for evaluated tasks without successes; never replaced by zero.
aggregation.scope: Exactly all four channels and episode indices 1..50 per task; no duplicate reruns or selection of individual episode outcomes.
